question:
Select the most appropriate synonym that can replace the underlined word in the given sentence.

It did not take her very long to __ascend__ to power.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"ascend"** means to move upward, to rise, or to climb. (चढ़ना)

 
 
• **Example:** The balloon began to **ascend **into the sky.
 
 
 
• **"Climb"** refers to going or coming up a slope or staircase; to rise gradually to a higher point or level. (चढ़ना)
 
 
• **Example:** She had to **climb** several flights of stairs to reach her apartment.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'ascend'** is **'climb'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Arise** (उठना): To emerge or become apparent.

 
 
• **Example:** New problems** arise** every day.
 
 
 
• **Grab** (पकड़ना): To take hold of something or someone suddenly.
 
 
• **Example:** He tried to **grab** the last cookie from the jar.
 
 
 
• **Reach** (पहुंचना): To arrive at a place, especially after some effort.
 
 
• **Example:** We finally **reached** the top of the hill.
